plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Pre-Health Occupations A.S. Degree (Full Time)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 16, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7474/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS, TRANSFER PATH. Total Units 61 = 15.5+15.5+14+16 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). The courses in this roadmap prepare students to apply for the Registered Nursing and Respiratory Care programs at ARC. GENSCI 90 and 91 are not degree applicable, but they help students maximize the likelihood of success; their units do not count toward the 60 units needed for this degree. Students are advised to take only one lab science class per semester and not to take a lab science class over the summer, to maximize their likelihood of success. This degree can be completed using either the local AA/AS GE pattern or the Cal-GETC transfer GE pattern; see a counselor. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. Elective courses: any elective courses numbered 100-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Registered Nursing admission: COMM C1000 and ANTH 310 are part of the Registered Nursing degree but can be taken prior to enrolling; minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 in BIOL 430, BIOL 431, and BIOL 440 or 442 (each with a 'C' or better) and minimum cumulative GPA of 2.5 in ENGL C1000/C1000H or ESLW 340, NUTRI 300, and PSYC C1000/C1000H; applications accepted in February for the following fall semester and September for the spring semester; the RN program has eligibility requirements and a selection process. Respiratory Care admission: AH 311 is required for admission; ENGL C1000 and ANTH 310 are part of the Respiratory Care degree but can be taken prior to enrolling; cumulative college GPA of 2.0 and cumulative GPA of 2.5 in AH 311, BIOL 430, BIOL 431, and BIOL 440 or 442 (each with a 'C' or better); the Respiratory Care program currently accepts students once per year for the spring semester beginning in January, with an application deadline of the second Friday in October.
